text:
lina.finance: Quick flag — PI Cloud (PI-91233) was billed extra usage last month because staging pipelines accidentally routed to the prod account. Need one-off retro credit + temporary special rate. Invoice INV-2024-0427 attached.

devon-sales: ah shoot, thanks for catching. what's the overage amount?

lina.finance: Overcharged 4,900,000 tokens across Mar 12–18. Billed at standard $0.0008/token = $3,920. Agreed pilot rate should've been $0.0004/token => $1,960. Proposed one-time credit = $1,960. Customer also requested a 30-day temporary rate of $0.00045/token while they finish migration.

anna.ops: Can you paste the invoice number and a sample usage CSV? Need invoice ref, GL code to post the credit, and a sales owner for audit.

lina.finance: Invoice INV-2024-0427. GL: 4102-credits. CSV snippet below for the affected rows:
```csv
account,project,usage_tokens,date
PI-91233,staging-job-7,2000000,2024-03-13
PI-91233,staging-job-8,2900000,2024-03-15
```

josh.fp: FYI if total credit < $5k we can do this without an SOW amendment. $1,960 looks fine from finance side. We just need a sales ops owner and the customer confirmation in writing.

priya.legal: Please confirm we have the customer's written acceptance of the adjustment. For audit, include phrase: 'one-time billing adjustment for misattributed staging usage.'

devon-sales: I can own it. Confirmed — customer rep Nathan (nathan.pi) replied yesterday accepting the credit and temp rate. I'll attach the email to the deal desk ticket. Sales approves.

billing-bot: system: invoice INV-2024-0427 status: posted. To adjust, please attach deal desk ticket ID in the credit request.

lina.finance: Deal desk ticket TKT-8045 created and linked. Sales owner: devon-sales. Requesting final sign-off to post the $1,960 credit and apply temp rate 0.00045/token for 30 days.

josh.fp: Approving $1,960 one-time credit and 30-day special rate $0.00045/token. Post credit to INV-2024-0427, GL 4102-credits, cost center PI-Cloud.

anna.ops: Got it — will post the credit today and update the invoice PDF and ledger. I will confirm once complete. :white_check_mark:

devon-sales: Thanks team :+1: I'll notify Nathan once it's posted and confirm the temporary rate window.
